outcome: Dose of intrathecal bupivacaine required for adequate surgical anesthesia
finding: Women of short stature required a lower dose of intrathecal bupivacaine for cesarean delivery compared to taller women, without an increased risk of complications.
mod_finding: The study investigated bupivacaine dosage for spinal anesthesia in women of short stature undergoing cesarean delivery but did not compare different modes of delivery.
